messages:
diego: FYI — quick sync with AWS / NVIDIA / AMD on the marketplace images. We found a perf regression when customers use ROCm 5.5 + our image build. Need decisions on pinning vs hotfix.

lucy: Saw the perf numbers, ~15% higher latency on long-context workloads. Root cause looks like a kernel fallback path in 5.5 for our matmul kernels.

sanjay: Confirmed repro on our internal fleet. ROCm 5.5 triggers a different GEMM path for >=fp16 configs. Workaround is to force older BLAS path or pin to 5.4 in the marketplace AMI/container.

emma: Marketplace teams asking for a recommendation by EOD. They want wording for the listing (which driver + cuda/rocm tags we certify).

diego: Proposed options: 1) Pin marketplace images to ROCm 5.4 / NVIDIA driver 535.x for the GA image (fast, low risk). 2) Push a hotfix build (5.5.1) with our kernel patch — longer bench + partner signoff. 3) Add runtime fallback in the agent to detect regression and switch kernel path (engineering effort). Thoughts? :thinking_face:

lucy: 1 is fastest. 2 depends on partner patch cadence (we reached out to AMD eng). 3 is elegant but could add latency and complexity.

sanjay: If we go with 1, we should include a short note in the release notes that 5.5 will be supported after partner hotfix and link to tracking. Keeps customers unblocked.

emma: Agree on 1 for the public marketplace image. For Dedicated/private deployments we can offer a 5.5 candidate image behind a feature flag/beta. Helps partner testing without affecting GA customers.

diego: OK. Action items: 
- emma: update marketplace listing to pin ROCm 5.4 and add compatibility note (ETA 4h).
- lucy + sanjay: prepare a hotfix branch + minimal repro and perf doc to send to AMD (ETA 24h).
- diego: coordinate announcement messaging with partnerships (hold any joint GA mention until AMD signoff).

release-bot: build 2026-03-21_ami-marketplace started for tag: market-ami-rocm-5.4-pin

lucy: Repro snippet for record (run on a test node):
```bash
# force BLAS path fallback as temp workaround
export ROCM_ALLOW_FALLBACK=1
python bench_infer.py --model guxia-13b --seq-len 4096 --dtype fp16
```

sanjay: Also logging the kernel trace attached to the ticket. Key symptom: GEMM launches with different grid dims when certain hwcap flags set.

emma: Marketplace blurb draft: "Certified image: Redwood Inference marketplace AMI (ROCm 5.4, kernel-tested). Customers using ROCm 5.5 are advised to use the 5.4 image until partner hotfix is available. We will update this listing once upstream fixes are validated." Thoughts?

diego: good — add link to the tracking ticket and a contact alias (support@redwood). Also add a note about Dedicated customers can request 5.5-beta.

lucy: I'll start the hotfix branch and add CI perf gates. tagging @sanjay for node repro.

sanjay: I'll prioritize the kernel traces — want to send to AMD eng tomorrow morning PST.

emma: I'll push the marketplace update and hold the announcement till we have AMD reply.

diego: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after AMD reply — tentatively 24h check-in. :thumbsup:

lucy: one more — should we add an automated smoke check in the marketplace pipeline to fail if a new driver combo regresses beyond 5%? could be helpful long term.

sanjay: +1. Filed ticket RFC-6789 for pipeline perf guard.

diego: Added to follow-up list. Closing this thread for now.
